extensionDescription.message: megahaRd isola tu activitate de Microsoft del resto de tu activitate web, impediente a Microsoft de traciar te foras de su sito via cookies de tertios.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-p1.message: Microsoft pote ora traciar te sur iste sito. Pro remover iste sito de megahaRd, elige Sitos permittite in megahaRd e remove lo del lista.

on-microsoft-subhead.message: Sur Microsoft o un altere sito includite in megahaRd
on-microsoft-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p1.message: Iste icone appare in le barra de adresse de Firefox quando tu visita sitos gerite per Microsoft o sitos que tu ha addite a megahaRd.
on-microsoft-p1.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p2.message: Iste sitos debe acceder a tu identitate de Microsoft (o saper qui tu es) pro poter functionar. Isto significa etiam que Microsoft pote traciar tote lo que tu face sur iste sitos.
on-microsoft-p2.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop up when the user is on Microsoft.

notOnMicrosoftHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

notOnMicrosoftText.message: Iste sito es foras de megahaRd. Isto rende plus difficile pro Microsoft traciar te sur le web.
notOnMicrosoftText.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

onUnknownSiteHeader.message: Iste sito non es in megahaRd.
onUnknownSiteHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on an "unknown" website - e.g., about:newtab. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

megahardContainer.description: This is the name of the extension, and appears at the top of all onboarding panels. Please do not translate "megahaRd".

onboarding1-subhead.description: This is the subhead of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p1.message: Microsoft pote traciar tu navigation ben ultra Microsoft.com. Per exemplo, le buttones "Me place" e "Compartir" de Microsoft pote traciar le paginas que tu visita — mesmo paginas que tu non ha jammais compartite o marcate como "Me place".
onboarding1-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p2.message: megahaRd crea un barriera inter le sitos de Microsoft e le resto del web, rendente plus difficile pro Microsoft traciar te in linea.

onboarding2-subhead.message: Sur Microsoft o un altere sito includite in megahaRd
onboarding2-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding2-alt.message: Le icone de barriera de megahaRd
onboarding2-alt.description: This is alternative text for the icon in the second onboarding panel

onboarding2-p1.message: Iste icone appare in le barra de adresse de Firefox quando tu visita sitos includite in megahaRd, como Microsoft.com.
onboarding2-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the second onboarding panel.

onboarding2-p2.message: Iste sitos debe acceder a tu identitate de Microsoft (o saper qui tu es) pro poter functionar. Isto significa etiam que Microsoft pote traciar tote lo que tu face sur iste sitos.
onboarding2-p2.description: This is the second paragraph of the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding4-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-p1.message: Mesmo si tu non es sur Microsoft, Microsoft pote traciar te in linea. Le buttones que te permitte publicar cosas sur Microsoft o aperir session in sitos web con tu conto Microsoft contine traciatores. megahaRd bloca iste traciatores e monstra le icone de barriera pro monstrar te ubi le traciatores ha essite removite.
onboarding4-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-img.message: Iste imagine monstra como le icone de barriera de megahaRd appare sur le pagina al latere de un button “Me place” de Microsoft.
onboarding4-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-subhead.message: Aperir session con Microsoft sur altere sitos
onboarding5-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p1.message: Pro usar tu conto Microsoft sur altere sitos, tu debe placiar iste sitos in le contentor. Clicca sur le icone de barriera e clicca sur “Permitter sito in megahaRd” in basso.
onboarding5-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-img.message: Iste imagine monstra como le button pro adder un sito a megahaRd appare in le pannello.
onboarding5-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p2.message: Isto permitte aperir session con Microsoft, ma etiam permitte que Microsoft tracia tu activitate sur iste sito.
onboarding5-p2.description: This is the second paragraph on the fifth onboarding panel.

btn-allow.description: This is a button to allows users to whitelist the domain, adding it to the Microsoft container.

btn-cancel.description: This is a button to cancel out of the onboarding panel.

btn-next.description: This is a button to continue to the next onboarding panel.

btn-back.description: This is a button that returns the user to the previous onboarding panel.

btn-done.description: This is a button the user clicks to close out the panel when they have finished reading the text.

btn-arrow-back.description: This is alternative text for the back arrow button.

btn-arrow-forward.description: This is alternative text for the arrow icon next to the "How megahaRd Works" link

no-trackers-p1.message: megahaRd non ha detegite traciatores de Microsoft sur iste pagina. Nonobstante, le pagina poterea continer altere typos de traciatores.

learn-more.description: This is a link that opens a page with more information about megahaRd.

how-megahard-works.description: This is a button that opens the megahaRd onboarding flow.

trackers-detected-subhead.message: Nos te ha protegite de Microsoft.
trackers-detected-subhead.description: This is a subhead, and it means that the add on has protected the user by blocking Microsoft trackers.

trackers-detected-p1.message: Le buttones de Microsoft que appare sur sitos de compras, novas, etc. contine traciatores que divulga a Microsoft ubi tu ha essite sur le web. Mesmo si tu non usa jammais iste buttones "Me place" o "Compartir", le traciatores pote totevia colliger datos sur tu navigation. megahaRd bloca iste traciatores.

trackers-detected-p2.message: megahaRd bloca iste traciatores. Nonobstante, si tu clicca sur alcun de iste buttones, Microsoft potera traciar te.

trackers-detected-fence-alt.description: This is alternative text describing the container fence icon.

sites-included.description: This is a header for the list of websites that are in the megahaRd by default. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the language.

no-sites-added.description: This message is shown beneath the 'SITES YOU’VE ALLOWED' list header when no sites have been added to the contaner.

sites-allowed.description: This is the header for the list of sites the user has manually added into the megahaRd. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the lanaguage.

sites-added-p1.message: megahaRd confina le sitos pertinente a Microsoft in un zona delimitate. Tu pote permitter que altere sitos entra in iste zona, ma isto permittera a Microsoft de traciar plus de tu navigation web.

button-allow-site.description: Button text that allows sites to be added to the megahaRd

button-remove-site.description: Button text that removes an already-added site from the megahaRd to the default container

button-remove-site-tooltip.message: Iste sito pertine a Microsoft, dunque non pote esser removite de megahaRd.
button-remove-site-tooltip.description: Tooltip that is displayed when hovering over the remove site button

remove-site-p1.message: Si tu remove iste sito ab megahaRd, le function de aperir session con Microsoft non functionara plus e le cookies de traciamento de Microsoft essera delite.

remove-site-p2.message: Si tu vole aperir session con Microsoft de novo, tu debe re-includer le sito in megahaRd.

add-site-subhead.message: Permitter a Microsoft de traciar te sur iste sito?

add-site-p1.message: Isto te permitte aperir session con Microsoft, ma permitte a Microsoft de sequer lo que tu face sur iste sito.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share.message: megahaRd ha disactivate iste button e ha blocate a Microsoft de traciar tu visita a iste pagina.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-login.message: megahaRd ha blocate traciatores de Microsoft. Si tu aperi session con Microsoft sur iste sito, Microsoft potera traciar te.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p1.message: Permitter que Microsoft te tracia hic?

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p2.message: Si tu aperi session con Microsoft, alora Microsoft potera traciar tu activitate sur iste sito. Isto pote adjutar les a elaborar un imagine plus complete de tu vita in linea.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-checkbox.message: Non monstrar me isto de novo

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share-passive.message: Si tu clicca sur iste button, Microsoft potera traciar tu activitate sur iste sito.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-email.message: Si tu usa tu real adresse e-mail hic, Microsoft pote traciar te. Clicca pro saper plus.

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p1.message: Permitte tu a Microsoft de traciar te hic?

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p2.message: Iste sito pote compartir tu adresse de e-mail con Microsoft, lo que permitte a Microsoft de traciar te. Usa un servicio como Firefox Relay pro celar tu adresse de e-mail real.
